output.summary: Contract cliff around vesting day 2027-04-01 (plus or minus 180 days) for Woking, Guildford, Waverley: 173 contracts end with no extension date recorded past vesting day, stated value GBP 22,671,525 (Woking 59 / GBP 8,086,069; Guildford 48 / GBP 12,074,355; Waverley 66 / GBP 2,511,101). 29 more have an extension date recorded past vesting day; 4 register entries have no usable end date. 45 cliff suppliers are also paid by another of the three councils. recommendations: Review the 5 largest hard-cliff contracts first: Managed Services for Temporary Agency Resources (Call-Off Contract under the ESPO MSTAR4 Framework Agreement 653F/23 dated 11 April 2023) (Guildford, ends 2027-04-14, GBP 8,500,000); WAV PT Architect and Consultant services & Cranleigh Leisure Centre new build project (Waverley, ends 2026-12-31, GBP 1,330,381); Insurance for Leaseholder Properties 2026 - 27 (Woking, ends 2027-03-31, GBP 1,221,492); Interim Contract for Strategic Assets Disposals (Woking, ends 2027-03-31, GBP 1,000,000); Housing Disabled Adaptations (Woking, ends 2027-03-31, GBP 997,800)

draft.title: IKEN 011240 Managed Services for Temporary Agency Resources (Call-Off Contract under the ESPO MSTAR4 Framework Agreement 653F/23 dated 11 April 2023)
draft.text:
Dear Comensura Limited,

Draft - not sent

Re: Managed Services for Temporary Agency Resources (Call-Off Contract under the ESPO MSTAR4 Framework Agreement 653F/23, dated 11 April 2023)

Ref: IKEN 011240

Our records show that the above contract, held under the Guildford register, is due to end on 14 April 2027. The stated value of this contract is GBP 8,500,000.

We are writing to request your confirmation on the future of this agreement in light of the upcoming vesting day on 1 April 2027. Please confirm whether you wish to novate this contract to the merged authority, extend the term, or allow the contract to expire on the stated end date.

Yours sincerely,

[Your Name/Title]

agents.name: Router
agents.role: Classifies a free-text request into a supported flow, extracts councils and parameters, or returns a structured unsupported error

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Runs federated SQL against the data layer (Zetaris live, cached council files in sample mode) and returns rows with provenance

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Validates provenance and thresholds on every result; rejects and returns work that does not clear the bar (one real bounce when needed)

agents.name: Resolver
agents.role: Normalises supplier names, scores cross-council matches, applies remembered decisions and Companies House identity; marks what still needs a human

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Drafts briefings and letters from the evidence table (NVIDIA Nemotron via Meterless Nightshift; deterministic template in sample mode)

agents.name: ApprovalGate
agents.role: Holds every draft for human approval and records human confirmations of supplier matches; no action is ever taken autonomously

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Meterless H-MEM: recalls earlier human decisions (supplier matches, approvals) and stores new ones with provenance
